open_points.subject: Import confirmation after an identical re-upload
open_points.text: A16 requires that confirming after another file upload be refused “also when the new file has the same bytes”, but M11 and A13 retain only the uploaded file and bind the confirmation to its digest and inputs; identical bytes produce the same retained facts and digest.
open_points.question: How does Registry distinguish replacement by an identical upload so that the earlier confirmation is invalidated?
options: Clear the pending confirmation whenever an upload is accepted.
Record an upload generation or nonce and bind the confirmation to it.
Treat identical bytes as the same file and allow the earlier confirmation, changing A16's refusal rule.
open_points.default_guess: Clear the pending confirmation on every accepted upload.

witness.initial: An owner session has no uploaded file and no pending confirmation.
events: Registry shows the import confirmation step, bound to digest D of F and the selected mapping.
The owner uploads the identical bytes F again; A16 says this replaces and drops the earlier upload.
The owner submits the earlier confirmation value.
outcomes: Applying A13's defined digest binding, the current file still has digest D and the confirmation is accepted; the import may commit.
Applying A16's identical-re-upload rule, the earlier confirmation is refused and the import changes nothing.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a successful import or a refusal requiring a new confirmation step.
